title: City Manager Search & Key Staff Roles
summary:
*   A special meeting was held primarily for confidential, closed-door discussions on personnel matters.
*   Key topics included the ongoing search for a new City Manager, a crucial leadership role for the city.
*   Discussions also covered the appointment of a Municipal Court Clerk and other general personnel issues.
*   **No final decisions, actions, or votes were taken** on any matters during this particular meeting.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
For SPECIAL MEETING - January 13, 1989 - 12:30 P.M.
THIRD FLOOR CONFERENCE ROOM - MUNICIPAL BUILDING Council Clumbers, 307 V\frst Second
Street, Austin, Texas Memorandum To: Mayor Cooke called to order the special called
meeting of the Council, noting the absence of Mayor Pro Tern Shipman.
Mayor Cooke announced the purpose of the meeting was to go into executive session,
pursuant to Article 6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated, to discuss personnel
matters. No final action, decision or vote by the City Council will be taken on any
subject or matter unless specifically listed on the agenda for this meeting.
1. Personnel Matters - Section 2, Paragraph g
(a) City Manager Search
(b) Appointment of Municipal Court Clerk
(c) Personnel Issues
Council recessed its meeting at 12:35 for executive session and adjourned its meeting at
4:15 P.M.
